purpose: Minimal .NET 8 WPF consumer boundary for displaying an image, drawing rectangle evidence, selecting one overlay, highlighting it, round-tripping view state, and showing validated read-only 3D-to-2D projection markers.

publicSurface.overlayGeometry: ImageCanvasSourceRectangle uses source-image top-left coordinates; Right and Bottom are exclusive.
publicSurface.selection: One programmatically selected overlay ID at a time; SelectionChanged reports selected metadata.
publicSurface.highlight: Selected rectangle is marked with the existing CanvasRect editing visual and a wider line; no new renderer is introduced.
publicSurface.threading: Session calls that touch the viewer must run on the WPF UI dispatcher.
publicSurface.lifecycle: Dispose is UI-thread-only, idempotent, and releases the native ImageCanvasControl through the existing ViewModel owner.
publicSurface.projection: ImageCanvasExternalProjectionResultReader validates schema 1.0, paired transaction identity, dimensions, finite coordinates, and exposes only valid in-bounds 3D-to-2D points for read-only marker replacement.

checks: Borrow and Clone caller bitmap remains usable
selection change and rejected reason round-trip
Fit -> Capture -> Apply -> Capture view-state round-trip
overlay visibility toggle and unknown-ID no-op
dynamic two-monitor placement on the smaller monitor on the left
physical HWND screenshot with current image and overlay evidence
3D Result watcher refreshes read-only reverse-projected markers after publication
projection marker screen performs no pipeline execution or layer mutation

explicitExclusions: direct marker connection to the OpenVisionLab application Pipeline Review
pipeline, layer, route, Preview, or Run ownership
